material.description:
scenarios/moba/assets/icons/ITEM-SOURCES.tsv:3-25 maps reaver->ancestor-totem, broadsword->arcane-wand, platemail->armored-skeleton, quelling_blade->air-blade, faerie_fire->fire-axe, blades_of_attack->attack-action; 99 item icons for ~260 items.items.osd entries.
Acceptance: Every item has an icon whose source row is marked placeholder vs 6.88g art, and items with no icon are listed; mismatched icons are replaced via hy3d/icon request.
Witness route: Lobby/shop screenshot-free check: icon file exists per item id (filename scan) and ITEM-SOURCES marks placeholders.
